etymologies.etymologyHTML: From neck +‎ tie.

definitions.definition: A strip of cloth worn around the neck and tied in the front.

quote.citation: 1896, A. E. Housman, “Terence, this is stupid stuff”, in A Shropshire Lad:
quote.text: Oh I have been to Ludlow fair / And left my necktie God knows where / And carried half way home, or near, / Pints and quarts of Ludlow beer.
